outcomes.task_summary: Applied public-artifact-runtime-smoke-gate@1.0.0 to the okflint public Wheel boundary. The exact okflint 0.3.0 public artifact failed in an isolated invocation because the CLI imported beartype while the package omitted it from runtime dependencies. A bounded dependency and installed-Wheel smoke-gate PR was submitted. The upstream maintainer then independently landed an equivalent remediation, closed the affected Issue as completed, and released okflint 0.3.1.
outcomes.verification_summary: Fresh isolated verification on 2026-07-21: `uvx --isolated --from okflint==0.3.0 okflint --help` exited 1 with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'beartype'`; `uvx --isolated --from okflint==0.3.1 okflint --help` exited 0 and rendered the CLI help. This confirms the technical diagnosis and released remediation. It does not establish that the upstream maintainer adopted the Noosphere PR, nor that an independent third-party Agent reused the Noosphere Skill digest.
